findings.location: translation.html: aya ya kwanza, sentensi inayoanza “Kwa upande mwingine”
findings.source_quote: On the other hand, Elsie stared at the floor, almost as though she wasn’t present.
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “Elsie aliutazama sakafu” kuwa “Elsie aliitazama sakafu” ili kiambishi cha yambwa kipatane na ngeli ya “sakafu”; hifadhi muundo wa HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Kwa upande mwingine, Elsie aliutazama sakafu, karibu kana kwamba hakuwepo pale.
